_about: linden: a 25s gallery-wall launch film for a generative media product, derived frame-by-frame from a 25.0s model launch film (1920x1080 @30fps). Authored on the 1280x720 stage, rendered at device scale 1.5: render.mjs --fps 30 --scale 1.5. Placeholder product: Linden Studio 1.0, a fictional model that makes pictures and short clips from a line of text. ONE wall of outputs on black and ONE continuous camera: the film opens on a single card drifting toward you while the wall fades up behind it, the card sinks back into its place, then the camera pushes, rolls and yaws across the wall onto a focus card, pulls back over the whole wall and dives into the gutter beside the first card. Three white lines follow on black: the name, a claim, and the mark with the address.
_sections: S1 0-18.6 the wall (linden-wall): A 0-3.3 one card alone, wall fading up in a pool of light | B 3.3-3.8 the card sinks into its slot, wall to full | C 3.8-11.0 push, roll and yaw onto the focus card | D 11.0-16.6 pull back and slide across the wall | E 16.6-18.6 accelerating dive into the gutter beside the hero card, ending on black | S2 18.67-20.23 name line | S3 20.27-21.8 claim line | S4 21.87-25.0 mark and address
_slots: 33 image slots on linden-wall: `hero` (the opening card, 2:3 portrait), `focus` (the card the camera lands on at ~11s, 2:3 portrait) and `media` (31 more, {src, label} each, filled nearest the hero first and cycled if shorter). Cards are 2:3, 3:4 and a few landscape; pictures are cropped to cover. Without them, drawn placeholder art (vistas, figure studies, glossy objects, bands, arcades) stands in. Plus `markSrc` on the last line for your own mark. Every piece of copy is a field: lead + text on each linden-line.
